name: Bromoketamine
summary: 2-Bromodeschloroketamine (also known as 2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM and bromoketamine) is a chemical compound of the arylcyclohexylamine class, which is an analog of the dissociative anesthetic drug ketamine in which the chlorine atom has been replaced with a bromine atom. Its specific pharmacological activities have not been studied.

uses.text: 2-Bromodeschloroketamine (also known as 2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM and bromoketamine) is a chemical compound of the arylcyclohexylamine class, which is an analog of the dissociative anesthetic drug ketamine in which the chlorine atom has been replaced with a bromine atom. Its specific pharmacological activities have not been studied. It has been sold online as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 2-溴去氯氯胺酮（英語：2-Bromodeschloroketamine），即溴胺酮（英語：bromoketamine），又稱2-Br-2'-Oxo-PCM、2-BDCK等，是一種芳基環己胺類化合物。它是解離性麻醉藥氯胺酮的結構類似物，但其中的氯原子被溴原子取代。
